jobs.title: Senior Director Product Management, Client Communications
jobs.description:
About the Job
The Client Communications organization is responsible for creating, assembling, validating, and delivering all client correspondences, contracts, and documents across digital and print channels.

The Senior Director of Product Management, Client Communications will be tasked with developing and executing a multi-year transformation roadmap spanning operations, business processes, and technology. Success in this role will require enterprise-scale execution, strong technical and AI acumen, and the ability to drive meaningful business outcomes.

What You’ll Do
- Lead and develop the product organization; recruit strong talent, establish high performance standards, and hold every team member accountable.

- Define objectives, key results, and roadmaps aligned with the enterprise strategy.

- Prioritize and define product requirements using data-driven methods and measurable business outcomes.

- Lead legacy modernization while ensuring accuracy, reliability, and regulatory compliance.

- Adopt the company’s AI-enabled Product Development Lifecycle to improve quality and speed with appropriate controls.

- Partner closely with the engineering organization and stakeholders across business domains, platforms, operations, legal, and compliance.

What You’ll Bring to the Role
- Expert ability to drive change in a large, matrixed organization and manage stakeholders across organizational boundaries.

- Strong technical and AI acumen, with the ability to assess architecture, integration, data, and modernization trade-offs.

- Demonstrated ability to modernize complex legacy ecosystems and manage dependencies, migration risk, and vendor relationships.

- Ability to constructively challenge established practices and deliver change across organizational boundaries.

- Strong developer of talent, setting high standards and holding others accountable to them.

- Concise and clear communication skills with the ability to translate effectively between business and technical audiences.

- High adaptability, learning agility, and decisive leadership through ambiguity.

- Relevant technical education or equivalent demonstrated proficiency preferred.

Skills You Have
- Business Influence: Collaborates, communicates and influences direct reports, stakeholders, and other business functions based on understanding of the marketplace, organizational needs, and the client as a people manager.

- Change Management: Acts as an advocate for change as well as identifying gaps/issues that should be addressed to deliver optimal client/field experiences. Leads change management, when driving technology or process improvements, applying relevant change acceleration, risk mitigation, and stakeholder management methodologies and best practices. Analyzes business trends and current state to develop a case for change that aligns with business strategy. Implements plans and strategies to manage organizational and behavioral changes by aligning leaders and engaging impacted stakeholders.

- Talent Development & Planning: Develops direct reports' skills based on organizational objectives, evaluates skill gaps, and manages succession planning to develop more capable direct reports, diverse, strong teams and better organizational performance in an equitable and inclusive manner.

- Technical & Digital Acumen: Leverages knowledge and approaches of digital products and technologies to solve problems, complete tasks and accomplish goals. Demonstrates effective adaptability to new and emerging technologies.

- Cross Functional Partnering & Planning: F acilitates collaboration, communication, coordination, and planning with individuals and teams from different functions within the organization, and who have different areas of expertise, to achieve common goals.

jobs.title: Product Strategist - Innovation
jobs.description:
About The Job
Variable is an innovation team within a Fortune 100 company. Our mission is to experiment with new technologies and ideas to understand the future. We are committed to encouraging a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment where innovation thrives. We drive impact at scale.
The Innovation Strategist is an entrepreneurial who leads work at the intersection of strategy and execution. Build the tools and experiences that empower our company, advisors, and help our clients thrive. Work with a talented team of engineers, designers, data scientists and financial experts to define product vision, strategy and deliver experiences to enable clients to achieve financial security.

What You'll Do
- Set Product Vision: Collaboratively define and communicate a clear vision for innovation experiments and new solutions, grounded in business strategy, customer insight, and emerging technology opportunity
- Develop Roadmap: Lead the development and socialization of a program roadmap that reflects stakeholder priorities, strategic bets, and a realistic path to value
- Define and Track KPIs: Establish measures of success for innovation experiments and use outcome data to validate strategic direction and inform go or no-go decisions
- Validate the Right Solution: Drive the discovery and definition phase of innovation programs, using research, stakeholder input, and experimentation to validate that proposed solutions address the right problems before committing to build
- Gather and Synthesize Requirements: Lead cross-functional work to identify, pressure-test, and prioritize requirements, translating ambiguous opportunity spaces into well-scoped program definitions
- Stakeholdering: Build and manage relationships with executive partners, business leaders, and technology stakeholders, proactively bringing strategic recommendations and leading conversations that shape program direction
- Executive Communication: Develop and deliver executive-ready briefings, narratives, and decision-support materials that make complex innovation work accessible and actionable for senior audiences
- User Insights: Anchor program decisions in qualitative and quantitative research, customer insight, and experimentation results, and synthesize findings into a clear strategic point of view and working with design partners to ensure concepts are grounded in this insight.
- Facilitate Ceremonies: Facilitate daily scrums, sprint planning sessions, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, continuously improving how the team operates
- Emerging Technology: Evaluate AI and other emerging technologies for strategic fit and enterprise applicability, leveraging a working knowledge of how these capabilities are evolving

What You'll Bring
- Bachelor's degree
- 5+ Years of prior experience with at least 4 working in a Product Management Role or innovation consulting, with agile team experience
- Knowledge Preferred: formal business analyst, engineering or testing experience, knowledge of the financial services industry, comfortable working in ambiguity, pressure-testing assumptions, and validating the right solution before committing to build
- Strong executive communication and storytelling skills, with experience developing materials for and presenting to senior leadership
- Working knowledge of AI and its practical enterprise applications, with an understanding of how capabilities are evolving and where the technology is heading
- Must have demonstrated cross functional work in previous experience along with strong communication skills, time management, project management skills, business acumen and high self-awareness/EQ
- Demonstrated previous research experience, influence skills, initial leadership exposure, ability to translate product requirements into technical requirements, and work in ambiguity and solutioning
- Solves complex problems; take a new perspective on existing solutions; exercise judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information

Skills You Have
- Cross Functional Partnering & Planning  - Facilitates collaboration, communication, coordination, and planning with individuals and teams from different functions within the organization, and who have different areas of expertise, to achieve common goals
- Strategic Thinking  - Uses critical thinking and knowledge of business demand to plan, design, prioritize and execute high impact initiatives and programs
- Attention to Detail  - Focuses on specific details to spot and correct errors in advance of them being found and surpass quality expectations. Performs work with thorough proofreading for presentation, content, accuracy, and overall quality
- Adaptive Communication  - Formulates strategies to be used to convey complex information about services, products, systems, or processes to targeted audiences; communicates and liaises between technical and non-technical audiences
- Analytical Thinking  - Organizes and compares various aspects of a situation to comprehend and identify key or underlying complex issues through the use of quantitative data and analysis; leverages strong business acumen, problem solving, and interpersonal skills to think critically about situations from multiple perspectives and consistently seeks ways to improve processes
- Customer Centricity  - Applies a customer first mindset to design and continuously improve solutions, systems, processes, and services that support enterprise strategy, impact critical business outcomes, and drive organizational success
